title: Alpine uses OpenRC instead of systemd
description: systemctl and journalctl do not exist on Alpine Linux.
recommendation: Use rc-service <svc> <action>, rc-update add <svc> default, and logread.
do_not_do: Never suggest systemctl or journalctl on Alpine Linux.

title: Alpine uses musl libc instead of GNU glibc
description: Precompiled binaries linked dynamically against glibc will fail to execute with 'not found'.
recommendation: Install gcompat or libc6-compat (apk add gcompat libc6-compat).
do_not_do: Do not attempt to run standard glibc binaries without compatibility layers.

title: Bash is not installed by default
description: Alpine uses Busybox ash as the default /bin/sh shell.
recommendation: Write standard POSIX sh scripts or install bash via apk add bash.
do_not_do: Do not rely on bash-specific syntax (bashisms) without ensuring bash is present.
